issue: A getter and a test control shared the input property name and prevented test-mode boot.
fix: Separated the input device getter and test input method.

issue: A full-thickness floating ledge obstructed the first gap landing.
fix: Authored thin optional platforms with clear walk-under space.

issue: The swim region stopped short of the riverbank exit.
fix: Extended buoyancy through the shoreline handoff.

issue: Object.assign froze an animation-state getter in the test API.
The focused menu arrow changed accessible button names, breaking exact-name selection.
A departed direct peer could leave a stale connected seat.
fix: Added departure signaling, connection-state recovery and a heartbeat timeout.

issue: Remote interact and jump pulses could be overwritten by a later packet before host simulation.
fix: Latched discrete commands until the host consumes them.

issue: A long multi-context software-GPU test run exhausted rendering contexts.
fix: Disposed rendering resources on page exit and isolated heavy test phases in fresh browsers.

issue: Long credits pages needed explicit controller scrolling and touch pan support.
fix: Added directional page switching, overflow scrolling and panel touch panning.
